newsitem.title: USA: Freeman nominated to head Los Angeles utility.
newsitem.headline: Freeman nominated to head Los Angeles utility.

text.p: David Freeman has been nominated to the top post at the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power (LADWP), the nation's largest municipal utility, the city's Mayor Richard Riordan announced Tuesday.

Freeman, who previously ran the New York Power Authority and held top positions at the Tennessee Valley Authority and the Sacramento Municipal Utility District, is currrently serving as trustee of California's independent system operator and power exchange.
The two entities are key elements of the state's plan to begin deregulating the electric services industry this January.

Since LADWP general manager William McCarley resigned in February, Harry Sizemore has held the post of interim general manager. The mayor said Tuesday Sizemore would continue at the LADWP as chief operating officer.
Freeman's nomination is expected to be confirmed by the full city council later this summer. He is expected to begin at the LADWP on September 1.
